title: decoding
description: Morphism: (handler-class, payload) -> utterance | rejection | obstruction. Locution -- the body's sensory transduction. Every channel the organism senses or acts through decodes into the SAME language (an utterance) for articulating to consume; senses and acts both speak utterances. NESTS INSIDE the structure (nothing is outside); does not write logs or fire downstream. The handler-class enum is now 5-class -- script-argv, hook-payload, http-request, and the formerly-deferred tool-call-envelope and llm-completion (D-H5 realized), so tool calls and model completions enter the substrate too.
